Title: Source 2: Adapted from Our Story
Author: by Levi Strauss & Co.
Content: When news of the California Gold Rush made its way to New York, Levi Strauss traveled to San Francisco in `text(1853)`. He went there to make his fortune, though he wouldn't make it panning gold. Levi established a dry-goods business. He called his company “Levi Strauss & Co.”

Levi Strauss worked with a clothing tailor named Jacob Davis. `text(One day)` someone asked Jacob to make a pair of pants for workers that wouldn't fall apart. Jacob tried to think of a way to make his pants stronger. He came up with the idea to put metal rivets¹ on the pants. These pants were an instant hit. Today, these denim² pants are called “jeans.”
